name: Bellvei (Spain)
description: Divided per saltire, white above and below and red at the hoist and the fly, charged at the centre with a yellow tower.
history: The official flag of Bellvei is oblong, of proportions two high by three long, quartered per saltire, white above and below and red at the sides, with a yellow tower closed in red of height 5/9 over all; it is a heraldic flag with the arms of the Bellvei family to which the tower existing in the village has been added. Published in the DOGC on 10 July 1991.

features.role: division per saltire, white above and below
